ns2:course.label: Capstone Seminar
ns2:course.description: Introduces advanced research themes, methods, and techniques for seniors in the Bachelor of Science in Sustainable Design. Emphasis is placed on students developing their own research topics, using multiple representational forms, including writing, drawing, mapping, and modeling. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: FAA 230 and FAA 330. Majors only. Senior standing required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: FAA 230 and FAA 330. Majors only. Senior standing required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Sustainable Design major(s). Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
